consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that despite the poor sound quality, the performance of the Grateful Dead at the 46th Street Rock Palace was energetic and memorable. Many attendees appreciated the unique venue and the overall vibe of the shows, highlighting the intensity of the Brooklyn audience.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 20 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the performance and the atmosphere, the consistently mentioned poor sound quality led to a more tempered overall sentiment.
